events.title: Friday Night with Linden Wood
events.description: Live Music: 4:30–7:30 PM | Local Food Truck We're bringing Friday Night Live Music with mulled wine warming on the bar, live acoustic music filling the cellar, and the character of our historic barn setting the scene. We're looking forward to a more intimate Friday at Christopher Cellars. Live Music with Linden Wood Joining us from 4:30–7:30 PM is Linden Wood , a Sacramento-based singer, songwriter, and guitarist whose music blends Americana, alternative country, roots rock, and acoustic storytelling. Performing since his early teenage years, Linden has spent more than a decade building a following throughout Northern California. His musical background stretches from intimate solo acoustic performances to heavier rock and metal, including appearances at the Warped Tour and performances alongside touring acts such as Trivium, Soulfly, Prong, and Floater. As a solo artist, Linden brings a roots-inspired sound, expressive vocals, and a natural connection with his audience. His ability to move between musical styles gives his performances a distinctive character, combining the energy of rock with the warmth and storytelling of Americana. We're excited to welcome Linden into the cellar for an evening where his music can be enjoyed in a more personal setting. Mulled Wine & Seasonal Sips We'll be serving warm, aromatic mulled wine , alongside our collection of small-lot Christopher Cellars wines available by the glass, bottle, or tasting flight. Nashville Blazin’ Chicken will also be on-site serving dinner throughout the evening. This will be an entirely indoor event, with limited seating available on a first-come, first-served basis. Arrive early to find a spot and enjoy live music in the cellar.

events.title: Wine Club Party
events.description: It's time to celebrate our final Wine Club release of 2026! On Saturday, November 14, Christopher Cellars will be closed to the general public and open exclusively to our Wine Club members and their guests for an afternoon of new releases, seasonal pairings, and a special library wine experience. To register please sign in to your wine club account and click the link below. Register Here Complimentary Wine Tastings & Seasonal Soup Pairings From 12–3:30 PM , the cellar will be open for complimentary tastings of our three featured Q4 Wine Club wines: 2025 Bacchus: A bright, aromatic white wine with fresh fruit character and lively acidity. 2023 Cabernet Sauvignon: A beautifully structured red with rich dark fruit and classic Cabernet character. 2023 Malbec: A bold, full-bodied red featuring dark fruit, spice, and firm tannins. To make this quarter's celebration a little more special, we'll be serving three seasonal soups, each thoughtfully paired with one of our featured Wine Club wines. This enhanced food and wine tasting experience is complimentary for our Wine Club members and their guests. A Special Library Release: Carignan from Mule Plane Vineyard We're also opening something particularly special from the Christopher Cellars library: Carignan from Mule Plane Vineyard. This limited-production wine is a rare opportunity to revisit a special vineyard expression from our cellar. With its depth, character, and food-friendly nature, it's a wonderful wine to bring to the holiday table. Extremely limited quantities will be available for purchase exclusively in the tasting room during this event. Once they're gone, we won't have more to offer. Complimentary Admission | Registration Requested There is no charge to attend, and Wine Club members are welcome to bring guests. Please register in advance so our team can plan accordingly and prepare enough seasonal soup pairings for everyone attending.

events.title: A Taste of Thanksgiving | Wine Pairing Experience
events.description: Christopher Cellars + Boulevard Bistro $40 Per Person | Three Culinary Bites & Three Wine Pairings Reserve Here Join us for a special afternoon celebrating the flavors of Thanksgiving through a thoughtfully curated wine and culinary tasting experience at Christopher Cellars. We've partnered with Chef Brett Bohlmann of Boulevard Bistro to reimagine three familiar Thanksgiving favorites into beautifully presented culinary bites, each thoughtfully paired with a Christopher Cellars wine. Presented one course at a time, each pairing invites guests to explore how seasonal ingredients, creative culinary techniques, and carefully selected wines complement one another. Chef Brett will personally plate and introduce each creation, sharing the inspiration and techniques behind the dish. Christopher Mora, owner and winemaker of Christopher Cellars, will guide guests through the accompanying wines, highlighting the vineyards, grape varieties, and characteristics that make each pairing unique. The Thanksgiving Tasting Menu First Bite | Roasted Butternut Squash & Sage Soup A silky purée of roasted butternut squash infused with fresh sage, finished with brown butter, crème fraîche, and toasted pumpkin seeds. Paired with 2024 Clairette Blanche | Fernow Ranch Second Bite | Crispy Thanksgiving Stuffing Crostini Golden, crisped Thanksgiving stuffing topped with whipped Brie, cranberry-shallot compote, and fresh thyme. Paired with 2024 Zweigelt | Mokelumne Glen Vineyard Third Bite | Roasted Turkey & Wild Mushroom Vol-au-Vent A delicate puff pastry filled with roasted turkey, wild mushrooms, and shallots, finished with sage-infused turkey gravy and crispy sage. Paired with 2023 Field Blend | Bartholomew Family Vineyard An Afternoon with the Chef & Winemaker Throughout the tasting, Chef Brett and Christopher will share the stories behind each pairing, exploring how acidity, texture, tannins, and seasonal ingredients come together to elevate familiar Thanksgiving flavors. Event Details Sunday, November 15, 2026 | 1:00 PM Christopher Cellars | Elk Grove, CA Tickets: $40 per person Your ticket includes three individually plated culinary bites, three paired wine pours, and guided presentations from Chef Brett Bohlmann and winemaker Christopher Mora. Seating is limited. Advance reservations are required. Reserve Here

events.title: Taco Tuesday
events.description: Join us this Tuesday as we bring the energy back to the start of the week. Maiz Mexican Catering will be on-site serving a lineup of bold, authentic flavors. Expect fresh tacos, vibrant salsas, and dishes built to pair perfectly with a glass of wine in hand. It’s casual, flavorful, and exactly how a Tuesday should feel. We’re pouring Sangria on tap! Bring your 1-liter flip top bottle and take home our custom house sangria, crafted to be refreshing, fruit-driven, and perfect for the season or enjoy it by the glass. No reservations needed. Come out, grab some tacos, and settle in with a glass. Tuesdays just found their rhythm.

events.title: R&B Night
events.description: Every Wednesday | 4–8 PM DJ Torrey Tee | 5:30–7:30 PM Make Wednesday nights a little more interesting at Christopher Cellars with R&B Night featuring our resident DJ, Torrey Tee. Join us inside the cellar for an evening of R&B, Hip-Hop, Bay Area classics, and throwbacks, paired with small-lot Christopher Cellars wines and great local food. Our tasting room is open from 4–8 PM , with wines available by the glass, bottle, or tasting flight, along with our signature wine slushies and other seasonal selection. Meet DJ Torrey Tee Torrey Tee is a Sacramento-based DJ, creative, and cultural curator known for his ability to read a room and create an atmosphere that brings people together. Blending R&B, Hip-Hop, Bay Area favorites, and familiar throwbacks, Torrey moves effortlessly between laid-back grooves and upbeat selections that keep the energy going throughout the evening. His experience spans Sacramento nightlife, festivals, weddings, corporate events, and community gatherings, including collaborations with Macy's, the City of Sacramento, St. HOPE, Coin-Op, and the R&B Running Series. Beyond music, Torrey is a photographer, filmmaker, and founder of Full Effect Films and Full Effect Entertainment. His creative background brings a thoughtful approach to every performance, making each Wednesday night feel a little different.

events.title: Live Band Karaoke Night with Karaoke Hero
events.description: Forget everything you know about karaoke. This isn't your typical sing-along night. We're welcoming Sacramento-based Karaoke Hero to Christopher Cellars for an evening of live band karaoke, where you don't just sing along to your favorite songs, you become the lead singer of the band. With a catalog of more than 700 songs spanning rock, pop, alternative, punk, metal, and more, Karaoke Hero brings the full concert experience to the stage. Pick your favorite song, grab the microphone, and perform alongside a live band of musicians. Not quite ready to sing? There's another way to join the fun. Karaoke Hero also offers an interactive Guitar Hero-style experience, allowing guests to play along with the band using a Guitar Hero controller. Whether you're taking center stage or enjoying the performances from your seat, it's an evening of live music, good company, and plenty of entertainment. Wine, Music & the Cellar We'll open our doors at 4 PM , giving you time to settle in with a glass of wine before the music begins at 5:30 PM. Our collection of small-lot Christopher Cellars wines will be available by the glass, bottle, or tasting flight throughout the evening. The event takes place inside our cellar, creating an intimate setting where guests can enjoy live music, discover new wines, and experience something a little different on a Thursday evening.

events.title: Friday Night with Jon Spivack
events.description: Live Music: 4:30–7:30 PM | Local Food Truck We're bringing Friday Night Live Music indoors with mulled wine warming on the bar, acoustic guitar filling the cellar, and the charm of our historic barn, we're looking forward to a more intimate Friday at Christopher Cellars. Live Music with Jon Spivack Joining us from 4:30–7:30 PM is Sacramento guitarist Jon Spivack, a seasoned musician who has been performing throughout the region for more than 25 years. Jon's music moves effortlessly between jazz, folk, blues, and Latin influences, drawing on a diverse repertoire of familiar melodies and timeless classics. His album Branching Out showcases his versatility, from solo jazz guitar to folk and blues duets and Latin-inspired arrangements. Having performed at venues including the Crocker Art Museum, Shady Lady, and several Northern California wineries, Jon brings a thoughtful, expressive approach to the guitar that's particularly suited to the intimate setting of our cellar. A local food truck will also be on-site serving dinner throughout the evening. This will be an entirely indoor event, with limited seating available on a first-come, first-served basis. Arrive early to find a spot and spend your Friday evening enjoying live guitar, a glass of wine, and the quieter side of the winery.

events.title: Holiday Cookie & Recipe Exchange
events.description: Sunday, December 13, 2026 | 1–3 PM Free to Participate | Advance Registration Required for Cookie Exchange Participants Some of the best holiday traditions begin in the kitchen. A grandmother's handwritten recipe, cookies baked with the kids every December, or a family favorite that always finds its way onto the holiday table. This December, we're bringing those traditions together at Christopher Cellars for Every Cookie Has a Story , a community holiday cookie and recipe exchange celebrating the recipes, memories, and people that make the season special. We invite you to bake a batch of your favorite holiday cookies, share the story behind them, and discover new recipes and traditions from others in our community. Register Here How the Cookie Exchange Works Bake 24 Cookies. Bring 24 Cookies. Take Home 24 Cookies. Register in advance to participate, then bake two dozen of your favorite homemade holiday cookies to bring to Christopher Cellars on Sunday, December 13. When you arrive, we'll collect and arrange everyone's cookies for the exchange. You'll have the opportunity to mingle with fellow bakers, discover different holiday treats, and fill a take-home box with 24 assorted cookies made by other participants. You'll leave with a delicious assortment of holiday cookies and perhaps a few new family favorites. Share the Recipe, Share the Tradition Every cookie has a story, and we'd love to hear yours. Along with your cookies, we encourage you to bring a recipe card featuring the ingredients, baking instructions, and a little note about what makes your recipe special. Is it something your grandmother made every Christmas? A recipe your children request every year? Or a new tradition you've started with your own family? We'll display the recipes as part of our Community Holiday Recipe Exchange , giving guests an opportunity to discover new recipes and take inspiration home for their own holiday baking. Who knows? Your family's favorite cookie might become someone else's new holiday tradition. Wine, Cookies & Community While the cookies are being exchanged, enjoy an afternoon at Christopher Cellars with our collection of small-lot wines available by the glass, bottle, or tasting flight. We'll also share a few suggested wine and cookie pairings for those interested in discovering how holiday sweets complement different wines. Bring your family, invite a friend, and spend the afternoon celebrating the simple joy of sharing something homemade.

events.title: Winemaker's Dinner at Americana House
events.description: Americana House | Appellation Lodi – Wine & Roses Resort & Spa 5 Course Dinner + Wine Pairing Experience | $130.00 per person + taxes & fees Make Reservation Join us for an intimate five-course winemaker dinner at Americana House, Lodi's newly reimagined dining destination by acclaimed Chef Charlie Palmer, located at the former Towne House Restaurant at Wine & Roses. This special evening brings together the seasonal, locally inspired cuisine of Americana House and the small-lot wines of Christopher Cellars. Each course has been thoughtfully created to complement the wines, highlighting the flavors, craftsmanship, and agricultural roots of the Lodi region. Christopher Mora, owner and winemaker of Christopher Cellars, will guide guests through the featured wines, sharing the vineyards, winemaking decisions, and stories behind each selection. The Five-Course Menu First Course | Roasted Golden Beets Chèvre mousse, satsuma mandarin, pistachio, mâche Paired with 2024 Christopher Cellars Picpoul Blanc Second Course | Lobster Pot Pie Lobster, leeks, fennel, puff pastry Paired with 2024 Christopher Cellars Chardonnay Third Course | Crispy Pork Belly White bean purée, braised escarole, apple-thyme jus Paired with 2023 Christopher Cellars Bartholomew Family Vineyards Field Blend Fourth Course | Grilled Striploin Potato pavé, king trumpet mushrooms, black pepper-Zinfandel jus Paired with 2023 Christopher Cellars Cherryhouse Zinfandel Fifth Course | Blood Orange Upside-Down Cake Candied orange peel, citrus-infused crème anglaise, vanilla Chantilly Paired with 2022 Christopher Cellars Barbera Brut Rosé Make Reservation

events.title: Deadly Holiday Gala
events.description: A Holiday Murder Mystery An elegant evening. A glamorous fundraiser. A murder no one saw coming. The holiday season is in full swing, and you're invited to one of the most anticipated social events of the year. A glamorous holiday fundraising gala brings together city council candidates, influential guests, and a few familiar faces, all dressed to impress and ready for a night of celebration. But behind the sparkling decorations, flowing wine, and polished smiles, tensions are running high. When a city council candidate turns up dead, the evening takes a deadly turn. Political rivalries, hidden agendas, and scandalous secrets begin to unravel as everyone becomes a suspect. Who had the most to gain? Who has something to hide? And who will be next? Join us at Christopher Cellars for an interactive murder mystery filled with unexpected twists, suspicious characters, and plenty of holiday glamour. Step into character, mingle with fellow guests, uncover clues, and work to solve the mystery before the killer gets away. Throughout the evening, enjoy spiked hot cocoa, warm mulled wine, and your favorite Christopher Cellars wines, along with a selection of appetizers and small bites. Get Tickets Your Ticket Includes $50 per person An interactive, character-driven murder mystery experience Your character assignment, clues, and mystery materials A selection of appetizers and small bites Your first beverage of choice Additional beverages will be available for purchase throughout the evening. Dress the Part Attire: Holiday Gala | Cocktail Glam Think elegant cocktail dresses, velvet, sequins, sharp suits, rich winter colors, and plenty of holiday sparkle. This is a glamorous fundraising gala, after all. Dress to impress, mingle with the city's finest, and remember that even the most charming guest could be hiding a deadly secret. Will You Uncover the Killer? Gather your friends, embrace your character, and prepare for an unforgettable evening where holiday glamour meets murder and mystery. Tickets are $50 per person. Space is limited, and advance reservations are required. The wine is flowing, the candidates are campaigning, and someone won't make it through the night.

We're looking forward to a more intimate Friday at Christopher Cellars. Live Music with Shane Q Joining us from 4:30–7:30 PM is Shane Q , Sacramento's own soulful vocalist and Top 10 finalist from Season 17 of NBC's The Voice . Shane gained national recognition in 2019 with his rendition of Chris Stapleton's "Tennessee Whiskey," earning a four-chair turn from the celebrity coaches before joining Team Kelly Clarkson. His musical style blends soul, R&B, country, and classic rock, drawing inspiration from artists including Stevie Wonder, John Mayer, and Michael Jackson. A familiar favorite at Christopher Cellars, Shane brings his rich vocals and acoustic interpretations of familiar songs back to the winery.
